name: produce output with zero external library dependencies
definition: compile with only standard system libraries, referencing no project-local modules or headers and no reads of the reference image file.
failure_mode: a reference to a local include, runtime file, or non-libc dependency because binary would fail the isolation run or the header check

name: read a chess position from an image
definition: Interpret a chess-board photograph/PNG into a structured legal position (piece placement, side to move).
